description: Ανάρτηση κενών θέσεων αδειών ίδρυσης φαρμακείων Περιφερειακής Ενότητας Κυκλάδων, κατά την 31 Μαΐου 2017 is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Περιφέρεια Νοτίου Αιγαίου. Het directoraat Volksgezondheid van de Cycladen kondigt de vacatures aan van apotheken in de regionale eenheid van de Cycladen, zoals deze zijn gecreëerd tot 31 mei 2017. Coverage: Περιφέρεια Νοτίου Αιγαίου. The portal shows the English title as "Розміщення вакантних вакансій для створення аптек в Регіональному підрозділі Кіклади, 31 травня 2017 року" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Περιφέρεια Νοτίου Αιγαίου. Its keywords include repository.data.gov.gr, Από μετάπτωση. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2026-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
